name: BLS Employment Situation September 2026 official release observed after publication

semanticGuards.firstPrintMeaning: This artifact preserves the official release content now observable on the BLS release page. It does NOT claim this project captured native BLS bytes at 20:30 on 2026-10-02.
semanticGuards.rule: Realization values and market surprise are separate objects. Without authentic pre-release consensus vintage, no standardized surprise is computed.

prohibited: constructing historical surprise from current web consensus
joining Taiwan returns before preregistered source/outcome gate

interpretation.absoluteActivityContext: Payroll +29,000 was below the same release's prior-12-month average gain of +45,000, but this is NOT a market surprise measure.
interpretation.revisionContext: The release revised July and August payroll employment lower by a combined 60,000. Revision magnitude is a separate release dimension, not part of headline payroll alone.
interpretation.vectorRule: Preserve payroll, unemployment, earnings, workweek and revisions separately; do not collapse to one macro score.

exactNext: On a future release, preserve native official response at release time with raw source attestation.
Capture authentic pre-release consensus from an approved provider before release or keep surprise UNKNOWN.
Keep release-vector components separate in D13-09/11 and test risk outcomes before direction.
Do not alter the Oct-2 pre-release object.
